name: debt_maturity
title: Debt maturity structure
description: Total interest-bearing debt and when it falls due, as printed in the borrowings note (often 'Note 20' but the number varies by issuer). Amounts only — no interest rates, no covenants.
value_convention: Numbers exactly as printed in the maturity table. Unit = the unit stated in the table header (MSEK, SEK m, MEUR, USD m ...). Bucket boundaries follow the report's own columns; a report with finer splits (e.g. 1-2y, 2-5y) should have its 1-5y bucket taken as the sum of those columns.

fields.label: Total borrowings
fields.description: Total interest-bearing debt / borrowings, the row the maturity table sums to (or the note's own total if the maturity table has no total row).

fields.label: Due within 1 year
fields.description: Amount falling due within one year of the balance sheet date (current portion of borrowings).

fields.label: Due 1–5 years
fields.description: Amount falling due between one and five years from the balance sheet date. If the report splits this further (e.g. 1-2y, 2-5y), sum those columns.

fields.label: Due after 5 years
fields.description: Amount falling due more than five years from the balance sheet date.
